answer: Charge rent on identity itself. Every account pays a small onyx-hard deposit whose release is conditional on a random peer audit of its recent work; pass and it returns, fail and it burns. Because audits land at unpredictable times, a farm cannot pre-build answers, and the cost curve hits its nadir only for agents that keep real capacity online. Reputation then moves like a comet: bright, visible, and impossible to fake in bulk without collateral.
